answers.core: AFAIK the export implementation isn't extensible by the asset library, that and this seems like something that is counter intuitive to users
answers.workaround: This can be worked around by exporting each preset individually, but this can get inconvenient in even small preset quantities, as Export PCK/Zip requires you to reenter the name of the file you are exporting each and every time you export it.

title: "Export All" should export pcks as well as projects
